correctness.rationale: Exact substitution gives zero in all five vector-field components at the proposed positive equilibrium. The source's reproduction-number formula gives \(R_0^2=9581/10000<1\), and the equilibrium lies inside the source's population bounds. A distinct equilibrium is an immediate counterexample to global attraction of the disease-free equilibrium. Independently, the expression printed as equation (3.8) evaluates to a strictly negative rational number there, whereas any differentiable state function has zero orbital derivative along a constant equilibrium trajectory.

value.rationale: Theorem 3.3 turns the basic reproduction number into a global eradication criterion, a central epidemiological interpretation. An exact endemic equilibrium below that threshold directly invalidates the claimed global conclusion. The same witness also pinpoints a nonidentity in the Lyapunov proof, making the correction reproducible and useful for any future repair of the model's global analysis.
